title: quire properties --json payload (v1)
description: The FR-052 per-criterion property-shape classification as emitted on stdout by `quire properties --json`. The envelope is assembled by `quire-cli`; every field inside a criterion comes from `AcClassification`, which this crate owns — so the contract is published here, in one place, and both sides conform to it rather than to each other. Hand-authored (`schemars` is banned, FR-003-AC-4). FR-008-AC-5 bans a version key in the payload, so the version lives in the `$id` and the filename.

EngineProvenance.description: Which instrument produced this payload (agent-ix/quire-cli#68, CR-104). Identical in shape and meaning to the definition in `coverage-v1.schema.json`; both are hand-authored per FR-055-CON-1, so the duplication is two artifacts stating one contract rather than one deriving from the other. NOT the contract version — that stays in the `$id` and the filename (FR-055-CON-2). This is provenance of the MEASUREMENT.

engine.description: The resolved `quire-rs` version actually linked, read from the `?tag=` / `?rev=` / `?branch=` locator of the consuming crate's lockfile entry, or the commit sha where the locator is absent — not that entry's `version` field, which for a git dependency is the dependency's own stale manifest constant. A `-<n>-g<sha>` suffix, a bare rev, or a branch name is carried VERBATIM and never rounded to the nearest tag.

capabilities.description: What this build can emit, as tokens. Deliberately open, and deliberately not version arithmetic.

document.description: The input label as the caller named it — a path, a glob expansion, or `-` for stdin.

criteria.description: Empty for a non-binding archetype (US, IT, …), which is data rather than an error.

row_id.description: The criterion's own id. Null when the binding form carries none; a downstream generator cannot emit a tracking tag without it.

statement.description: The UNTRUNCATED statement. Every span offset indexes this field.

property.description: The FR-052 property-shape axis. Closed in the engine by FR-052-CON-3: a shape with no downstream generator silently drops criteria, so extension happens by declaring idiom phrases, never by adding a shape.

extraction.description: CR-033: what a generator may do with this criterion. Derived from `property` and `extractable` alone.

signals.description: Stable ids of the signals that fired, in evaluation order. There is no confidence float — a float is unreviewable and invites threshold tuning; this trail is what makes every record re-derivable from its own output.

obligation.description: FR-053. Null for a module declaring no `obligations:` source. Carries no id, statement or document: the criterion record and its enclosing document object already have all three.

SpanOrNull.description: A span carries both byte offsets and its own text: offsets so a consumer can assert the decomposition partitions the statement, text because handing a UTF-16 consumer raw UTF-8 byte offsets is a defect generator.

parameters.description: Omitted entirely when the source declares no parameters or every declared cell is empty.
